content.title: DISH blackout for American Idol? Easy ways to watch new episode for free today
content.text: Updated: Mar. 16, 2026, 5:43 p.m.Published: Mar. 16, 2026, 5:43 p.m.If you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.“American Idol” season 24 shifts into high gear with Top 20, Part 1 from Aulani, a Disney Resort & Spa in Ko Olina, Hawaiʻi. Episode 8 airs today, Monday, March 16, at 8 p.m. Eastern. Brad Paisley and Keke Palmer mentor the Top 20.Palmer also joins the panel as a guest judge, and the episode features performances from Iam Tongi and Thunderstorm Artis—a sun‑splashed showcase that blends coaching, star cameos and rising‑star momentum.“Idol” fans currently have multiple streaming options to watch tonight’s episode.Where can I watch “American Idol” without DISH Network?If you are among the millions of customers currently affected by the carriage dispute between DISH Network and Gray Media, you may have noticed broadcasting staples including ABC missing from your lineup. Despite the ongoing network blackout, you have multiple safe options to watch tonight: Fubo, which offers a free trial, has three main packages: Pro costs $79.99/month, Elite costs $89.99/month and Premier is priced at $99.99/month. Cancel before the free trial ends to avoid charges. Fubo includes access to more than 185 sports, entertainment and news channels and allows you to record TV shows, movies, games and more.Watch Fubo for freeGet Fubo's free trial and up to $30 off your first month of service.Try Fubo FreeDIRECTV, which also gives customers a free trial, offers four packages if you continue with the service after your trial ends: Entertainment for $69.99, Choice for $84.99, Ultimate for $109.99 and Premiere for $159.99. Choice offers the most channels for sports enthusiasts.Watch DIRECTV for freeGet a five-day free trial and up to $40 off your first month of DIRECTV.Get DIRECTV FreeSling TV offers several pricing options: a $4.99 Day Pass, a $9.99 Weekend Pass, a $14.99 Week Pass, a Monthly Pass for $45.99 (with half off the first month) or a Season Pass for $199.99 for five months (then $45.99 per month). Subscribers can also choose between the Blue package or the Orange package depending on viewing preferences. You can also subscribe to either the Blue package or the Orange package depending on your viewing preferences. Sling Blue allows up to three streams at a time, and Sling Orange allows one stream at a time. It’s common for Platinum holders to open or anchor performance blocks.Aulani mentors and a guest judge twist: With Keke Palmer both mentoring and guest‑judging—and Brad Paisley back—watch how advice translates into arrangement choices. America’s vote coming into view: The Top 20 arc spans two weeks from Hawaiʻi.
